# Synthetic engineering parser fixtures

These retained workbooks are synthetic test inputs generated by `tests/test_excel_balance.py`; they are not industrial validation benchmarks. Each successful parse also writes its full structured result to the workspace's ignored `outputs/balance-parser-tests/` directory. Malformed/hostile inputs are retained there rather than mixed with engineering examples. The user's Protein-from-Air workbook is copied only to that private output directory.

Use `cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_excel_balance.py -q` to regenerate the fixtures and results. Test fixtures include independently specified expected conversions, balance residuals, statuses, source-cell addresses and contradictory descriptions. Formula-cache tests inject a specified stored result into the synthetic OOXML fixture; no spreadsheet formula is executed. `xlwt` is a dev-only BIFF fixture writer; runtime `.xls` parsing uses xlrd.
